aiSummary.oneLiner: Curated, time-filtered lists of LeetCode problems mapped to specific tech companies to streamline interview preparation.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository provides highly targeted preparation materials for software engineering interviews by grouping LeetCode problems according to the companies that frequently ask them. It organizes questions chronologically—covering the last 30, 60, and 90 days—giving candidates a clear picture of current hiring trends. The technical approach relies on meticulously maintained CSV and Markdown files that map directly to LeetCode's proprietary tags. What sets this apart is its focus on recent data, ensuring candidates aren't studying outdated problem sets. It serves as an essential index for optimizing limited study time before high-stakes technical screens.
keyFeatures: Company-Specific Grouping: organizes problems by top-tier tech companies so candidates can target their preparation efficiently.
Time-Based Filtering: segments questions by recent appearance (30, 60, 90 days) to highlight current interview trends.
Direct Integration: provides exact mappings to LeetCode, eliminating the need to search for matching problem descriptions.
System Design Addendum: includes supplementary notes and links for the system design portions of technical interviews.
Continuous Updates: maintains relevance by regularly syncing with the latest candidate reports and platform tags.

useCases.title: Targeted Interview Prep
useCases.description: Candidates applying to specific companies like Google or Meta use this to focus exclusively on problems known to be in those companies' active question banks.

useCases.title: Trend Analysis
useCases.description: Educators and mentors analyze the time-filtered lists to understand how technical interview standards are shifting over time.

useCases.title: Last-Minute Review
useCases.description: Job seekers with imminent interviews rely on the 30-day lists to drill the most highly probable questions.

useCases.title: Mock Interview Scenarios
useCases.description: Study groups select problems from specific company folders to simulate realistic, company-tailored mock interviews.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This resource is designed for software engineers, computer science students, and anyone actively preparing for technical coding interviews at major tech companies. It requires a basic understanding of data structures and algorithms.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Clone the repository or browse the Markdown files directly on GitHub to find your target company.
